text: **SLA** — the target time within which a request or issue should be resolved. - **Escalation** — handing a case to a specialist team when first-line steps do not resolve it. ## Worked Example During a routine interaction, the agent identifies this scenario, applies the documented process, and confirms with the customer before closing the case. ## Common Mistakes - Skipping identity verification before making account changes. - Closing a case before the customer confirms the issue is resolved. ## Escalation - Where first-line steps do not resolve the issue within the stated timeframe, the case is escalated to the next tier with full interaction history attached, and the customer is informed of the new reference and expected timeline. ## Knowledge Check 1. What is the first step before making any account change? 2. When should a case be escalated rather than retried? ## Related Documents No directly linked documents are recorded for this item; refer to the relevant department for further guidance.
